image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a common iguana resting on a textured, dark surface (likely rock or wood). The image focuses on the head, shoulder, and front limb. The iguana displays characteristic green and greyish coloration with a prominent dorsal crest of spines along the neck and back. The skin texture shows detailed granular scales on the body and larger plate-like scales on the head. One front limb is clearly visible with distinct digits and claws.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head structure is visible, showing the triangular shape and the beginning of the dewlap area under the jaw, consistent with an iguana.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is partially visible but heavily shadowed and angled away; pupil shape and iris color cannot be definitively verified due to lighting and angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The large circular scale characteristic of the subtympanic shield is clearly visible on the side of the head below the ear region.
The visible portion of the torso appears thick and muscular, consistent with a robust reptile body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows a mix of green and grey/brown tones with darker banding patterns on the shoulder and neck, matching adult coloration descriptions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct row of white-tipped, spine-like scales forms a crest along the neck and upper back, clearly visible and structurally sound.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: High-resolution detail shows the transition from smaller granular scales on the neck/body to larger, irregular plate-like scales on the snout and cheek.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front left limb is fully visible, showing muscular definition, five distinct digits, and sharp claws. No fusion or missing digits observed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail extends out of the frame immediately behind the shoulder area; its full length and compression cannot be verified.
